passages.text: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?
passages.sermon: Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.\r\nCan you catch Leviathan with a hook?\r\nCan you tie down Leviathan’s tongue with a rope?
passages.original: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
passages.sermon: Leviathan is a powerful and untamable creature.\r\nYou cannot put a cord through Leviathan’s nose.\r\nYou cannot pierce Leviathan’s jaw with a hook.
passages.original: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ׃

passages.text: Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly?
passages.sermon: Leviathan is a powerful and untamable creature.\r\nHe will not beg you for mercy.\r\nHe will not speak to you softly.
passages.original: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם־ יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Will he make a covenant with you to take him as a slave for life?
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Leviathan.
Leviathan is a powerful sea creature.
Leviathan is not under human control.
Will Leviathan make an agreement with you?
Will Leviathan promise to serve you forever?
Can you take Leviathan as your slave for life?
passages.original: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens?
passages.sermon:
God describes Leviathan.
Leviathan is a powerful sea creature.
You cannot treat Leviathan like a pet.
You cannot play with Leviathan as you would with a bird.
You cannot tie Leviathan up for your young women.
Leviathan is not tame or harmless.
passages.original: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק־ בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
\r\nTraders cannot bargain for Leviathan.
\r\nMerchants cannot divide Leviathan among themselves.
\r\nNo one can treat Leviathan as ordinary goods.
passages.original: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃

passages.text: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
You cannot fill Leviathan’s hide with harpoons.
You cannot pierce Leviathan’s head with fishing spears.
Leviathan cannot be captured or harmed by human weapons.
passages.original: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and dangerous creature.
If you touch Leviathan, you will face a fierce battle.
You will remember that battle.
You will not try to fight Leviathan again.
passages.original: שִׂים־ עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־ תּוֹסַֽף׃

passages.text: Surely hope of overcoming him is false. Is not the sight of him overwhelming?
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and terrifying creature.
No one can defeat Leviathan.
Anyone who hopes to overcome Leviathan will be disappointed.
Even seeing Leviathan is overwhelming.
passages.original: הֵן־ תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל־ מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל׃

passages.text: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan. Then who is able to stand against Me?
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and terrifying creature.
No person is fierce enough to wake Leviathan.
No one dares to challenge Leviathan.
God is greater than Leviathan.
No one can stand against God.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְפָנַ֥י יִתְיַצָּֽב׃

passages.text: Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God asks a question.
God says, "Who has given anything to Me first?"
God says, "No one has given to Me before I gave to them."
God says, "I do not owe anyone anything."
God says, "Everything under heaven belongs to Me."
passages.original: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם לִי־ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: I cannot keep silent about his limbs, his power and graceful form.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Leviathan.
\r\nLeviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
\r\nGod says, "I cannot keep silent about Leviathan's limbs."
\r\nLeviathan's limbs are strong.
\r\nLeviathan is powerful.
\r\nLeviathan has a graceful form.
passages.original: לֹא אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר־ גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who can approach him with a bridle?
passages.sermon:
God describes the Leviathan.
The Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
No one can strip off the Leviathan’s outer coat.
No one can approach the Leviathan with a bridle.
passages.original: מִֽי־ גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: Who can open his jaws, ringed by his fearsome teeth?
passages.sermon:
The subject is a mighty creature called Leviathan.
\r\nLeviathan has a powerful mouth.
\r\nNo one can open Leviathan’s jaws.
\r\nLeviathan’s teeth surround his mouth.
\r\nLeviathan’s teeth are terrifying.
passages.original: דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣יו אֵימָֽה׃

passages.text: His rows of scales are his pride, tightly sealed together.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful sea creature.
Leviathan has rows of scales.
These scales are his pride.
The scales are tightly sealed together.
passages.original: גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר׃

passages.text: One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a mighty sea creature.
His body is covered with scales.
Each scale touches the next scale.
No air can pass between the scales.
passages.original: אֶחָ֣ד בְּאֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ לֹא־ יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They are joined to one another; they clasp and cannot be separated.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a great sea creature.
His scales cover his body.
Each scale touches the next scale.
The scales join tightly together.
No scale comes apart from another.
The scales stay connected.
Nothing can separate the scales.
passages.original: אִישׁ־ בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: His snorting flashes with light, and his eyes are like the rays of dawn.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes Leviathan.
Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
When Leviathan snorts, light flashes out.
Leviathan’s eyes shine brightly.
His eyes are like the rays of dawn.
passages.original: עֲ‍ֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־ שָֽׁחַר׃

passages.text: Firebrands stream from his mouth; fiery sparks shoot forth!
passages.sermon:
The subject is a powerful creature called Leviathan.
Leviathan is a sea monster.
Leviathan is very strong and terrifying.
Fire shoots from Leviathan’s mouth.
Flames come out like torches.
Sparks of fire fly out quickly.
Leviathan’s mouth sends out burning fire.
passages.original: מִ֭פִּיו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃

passages.text: Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
passages.sermon:
Smoke comes from his nostrils.
The smoke pours out strongly.
It looks like steam from a boiling pot.
It is like smoke rising from burning reeds.
passages.original: מִ֭נְּחִירָיו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן׃

passages.text: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames pour from his mouth.
passages.sermon:
The subject is a powerful creature called Leviathan.
Leviathan breathes out hot air.
His breath makes coals burn brightly.
Flames come out from his mouth.
passages.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃

passages.text: Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful creature.
\r\nStrength lives in his neck.
\r\nDismay jumps ahead of him.
passages.original: בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה׃

passages.text: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful creature.
His flesh has many folds.
The folds of his flesh are tightly joined together.
His flesh is firm.
His flesh does not move or shift.
passages.original: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל־ יִמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: His chest is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone!
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful creature.
\r\nHis chest is very hard.
\r\nHis chest is as hard as a rock.
\r\nHis chest is as hard as a lower millstone.
passages.original: לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ־ אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק כְּפֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית׃

passages.text: When Leviathan rises up, the mighty are terrified; they withdraw before his thrashing.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful and fearsome creature.
When Leviathan rises up, strong men feel fear.
Mighty warriors become afraid.
They tremble when Leviathan moves.
They retreat from his violent thrashing.
passages.original: מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃

passages.text: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or dart or arrow.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a mighty creature.
He is extremely strong.
A sword cannot harm him.
A spear cannot harm him.
A dart cannot harm him.
An arrow cannot harm him.
Weapons have no effect on Leviathan.
passages.original: מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃

passages.text: He regards iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood.
passages.sermon: Leviathan is a mighty and terrifying creature.\r\nHe sees iron as if it were straw.\r\nHe sees bronze as if it were rotten wood.
passages.original: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְתֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְעֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: No arrow can make him flee; slingstones become like chaff to him.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes a creature that is extremely strong and fearless.
No arrow can make this creature run away.
Slingstones are like chaff to him.
He does not fear weapons.
Weapons have no effect on him.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן־ קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־ ל֥וֹ אַבְנֵי־ קָֽלַע׃

passages.text: A club is regarded as straw, and he laughs at the sound of the lance.
passages.sermon:
The subject is Leviathan.  
Leviathan is a powerful sea creature.  
He thinks a club is like straw.  
He hears the sound of a lance.  
He laughs at it.
passages.original: כְּ֭קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃

passages.text: His undersides are jagged potsherds, spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge.
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a powerful creature.
His underside is covered with sharp, broken pieces like potsherds.
He presses hard against the ground.
He spreads out the mud beneath him like a threshing sledge.
passages.original: תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי־ טִֽיט׃

passages.text: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
passages.sermon:
The creature is powerful and fearless.
He stirs up the deep waters.
He makes the depths boil like a cauldron.
He makes the sea bubble like a pot of ointment.
passages.original: יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃

passages.text: He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
passages.sermon:
Leviathan moves through the water.
He leaves a shining path behind him.
The water glistens where he passes.
People see the trail in the sea.
They think the deep looks like it has white hair.
passages.original: אַ֭חֲרָיו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃

passages.text: Nothing on earth is his equal— a creature devoid of fear!
passages.sermon:
This creature has no equal on earth.
God made this creature without fear.
No other being matches him.
He is completely fearless.
passages.original: אֵֽין־ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי־ חָֽת׃

passages.text: He looks down on all the haughty; he is king over all the proud.”
passages.sermon:
Leviathan is a creature with no equal on earth.
Leviathan has no fear.
Leviathan sees every person who is proud.
Leviathan looks down on all who are haughty.
Leviathan is king over all who are proud.
passages.original: אֵֽת־ כָּל־ גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ שָֽׁחַץ׃ס
